topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: A 41% antenna efficiency necessitates higher transmitted power, impacting the carrier-to-noise ratio (C/N0) and reducing the link margin. This effect is more pronounced in GEO-LEO satellite links and high-data rate applications, where power constraints and reliability are critical factors. To mitigate these effects, design modifications and optimizations, such as using higher-gain antennas, optimizing power management systems, and implementing advanced RF circuit designs, can be employed. However, these modifications involve trade-offs and considerations, including increased complexity, cost, and power consumption, which must be carefully evaluated to ensure optimal performance and reliability.
